source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: Mobitz I progressively prolongs PR before a blocked beat. In Mobitz II, conducted beats have constant PR while some P waves are not followed by QRS complexes.

authored_choices.blockedSlot: The final P wave in each group.
authored_choices.twoToOne: Presented separately as 2:1 block; the ratio alone does not assign Mobitz I or II.

limitations: The Mobitz II teaching example has narrow QRS only; broad QRS with bundle block has not been added.
No anatomical block location, random dropped beats, filling or beatwise ejection-volume model.

Switching from atrial flutter/fibrillation, ventricular flutter/fibrillation or third-degree AV block loads the complete template and resets previous parameters. Manual edits still require validation.
